title: Sum of noisy influences
statement:
Fix an integer $n$ and a real number $\rho$, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function. Summing the noisy influence at noise rate $\rho$ over all coordinates $i\in[n]$ gives
\[
  \sum_{i=1}^{n} \mathrm{Inf}_i^{\rho}[f]
  \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \abs{S}\,\rho^{\,\abs{S}-1}\,\hat f(S)^2,
\]
where the right-hand sum ranges over all subsets $S$ of $[n]$.
hypotheses_covered: arity n and a Boolean function f : {0,1}^n → ℝ
a real noise rate ρ (no constraint imposed)
right-hand sum over all subsets S ⊆ [n]
